### ICON partners with Anthropic in multi-year collaboration to deploy Claude's frontier AI across the clinical trial lifecycle


ICON's multi-year collaboration with Anthropic will bring Claude's AI capabilities to key clinical development workflows, helping accelerate innovation and enhance the delivery of clinical trials worldwide.
